A food item which restores energy when consumed.  It can be made in the [[oven]] or purchased from [[Horadric]] in [[The Dead Horse]].  The quality is dependent on the ingredients used as well as any [[perks]] or [[sermons]] that might be active.  Higher quality meals have a larger restorative effect when consumed.  For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].
